mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.name, p.code, p.department_id, d.name as department_name, p.level, p.description, p.status, p.user_count, p.created_by, p.updated_by, p.created_at, p.updated_at, p.deleted_at FROM position p LEFT JOIN department d ON p.department_id = d.id WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY p.created_at DESC

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.code, p.department_id, d.name as department_name, p.level, p.description, p.status, p.user_count, p.created_by, p.updated_by, p.created_at, p.updated_at, p.deleted_at FROM position p LEFT JOIN department d ON p.department_id = d.id WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.code, p.department_id, d.name as department_name, p.level, p.description, p.status, p.user_count, p.created_by, p.updated_by, p.created_at, p.updated_at, p.deleted_at FROM position p LEFT JOIN department d ON p.department_id = d.id WHERE p.code = #{code} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.code, p.department_id, d.name as department_name, p.level, p.description, p.status, p.user_count, p.created_by, p.updated_by, p.created_at, p.updated_at, p.deleted_at FROM position p LEFT JOIN department d ON p.department_id = d.id WHERE p.department_id = #{departmentId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY p.level ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO position (name, code, department_id, level, description, status, user_count, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{code}, #{departmentId}, #{level}, #{description}, #{status}, #{userCount}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE position SET name = #{name}, code = #{code}, department_id = #{departmentId}, level = #{level}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM position WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM position WHERE code = #{code} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM position WHERE code = #{code} AND id != #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE position SET user_count = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user WHERE position_id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL ) WHERE id = #{id}
